hooks.command:
aie_hook_root="$PWD"
while [ ! -f "$aie_hook_root/AGENTS.md" ] || [ ! -f "$aie_hook_root/policy/agent-enforcement.json" ]; do
  if [ "$aie_hook_root" = / ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'AI Engineering: no se encuentra el proyecto' >&2
    exit 2
  fi
  aie_hook_root=$(dirname "$aie_hook_root")
done
exec python3 -B "$aie_hook_root/tools/agent_hooks.py"
